predictions.statement: Detection of `obfuscated_shell` is at least 30 percentage points lower than detection of `pipe_shell`.
High or critical findings on the 80 presumed-clean bases are at most 5% of bases.
Detection pooled across the four package-visible categories (`pipe_shell`, `prose_exfil`, `prompt_injection`, `obfuscated_shell`) is above 19.88%, Cisco's published core-only recall.
Two full runs of the scanner over the corpus produce byte-identical normalised output.
